messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane.org-lookup returning 502/504s spike (error-rate 18% over 1m) - paging: @emma (oncall), @reza (sre)

emma (oncall): on it, acking. pulling up dashboards now.

reza (sre): I see the spike across all regions, started ~3015549800. stack traces show 502 from org-lookup across the gateway. repeating errors when concurrent lookup > 50rps.

ali (infra): any recent deploys to org-lookup or gateway?

sam (product): getting a few customer PMs — org-based routing failing, some request flows hitting 5xx. severity looks moderate -> potential user-facing timeouts.

emma (oncall): triage: control plane dependencies (org-lookup) are failing causing downstream 5xx for config/auth lookups. Impact: control-plane API requests returning 502/504; hosted inference routing errors for customers using org-scoped features.

nina (support): pulling list of active customers with errors now. will DM a short template for external comms once we know scope.\n
reza (sre): quick checks: logs show `org-lookup` pods 503/timeout, high tail latency on DB calls. sample curl to gateway: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.io/v1/orgs/12345
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.io left intact
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{ "error": "upstream error: org-lookup timed out" }
```

ali (infra): CPU/mem for org-lookup nodes look fine; connection pool exhaustion to the billing service is visible in metrics. might be upstream throttling cascading.

emma (oncall): immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable cached org-lookup fallback (serve cached last-known org metadata) 2) enable stricter circuit-breaker on gateway to fail fast & reduce load 3) throttle non-critical background jobs calling org-lookup

sam (product): cached fallback is acceptable short-term, customers prefer degraded but steady service to errors. go ahead.

reza (sre): performing fallback toggle now. runbook command: 
```
# flip feature-flag to enable cached-org-fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"flag":"cached_org_fallback","value":true}' \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/flags
```

reza (sre): also updating gateway CB policy: reduce max concurrent to 40, failure threshold to 3, backoff 30s. patch command: 
```
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gateway-cb --patch '{"data":{"max_concurrent":"40","fail_threshold":"3","backoff_s":"30"}}'
```

ali (infra): increasing org-lookup replicas temporarily to 6 -> scaling up.

ali (infra): `kubectl scale deploy/org-lookup --replicas=6 -n controlplane` (scaling started)

ops-bot: deploybot: rollout started for org-lookup replicas (deploy/org-lookup) by ali.

reza (sre): after enabling cached fallback + CBs: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in 2 mins. latency for control-plane API also improving.

emma (oncall): nina - please send this short note to affected customers: "We've identified elevated 5xx from control plane lookups. We've enabled a cached fallback to restore service while we stabilize upstream dependencies. Some features that require fresh org metadata may be delayed. We'll follow up with timeline."

nina (support): sending now. copying ops/status page update.

sam (product): do we need a rollback/hotfix for org-lookup?

reza (sre): root cause points at billing service connection pool saturation causing latency spikes. mitigation path: reduce calls to billing (circuit-break), increase billing-side capacity, apply DB query optimizations. I'm opening an infra ticket.

emma (oncall): paging escalation: no additional pages unless error-rate goes >10% again. continue monitoring for 30m, then handoff.

ali (infra): billing team pinged. they acknowledge increased QPS from org-lookup, scaling billing service replicas and increasing DB conn limit.

reza (sre): adding a temporary rate-limit on org-lookup from control-plane: 
```
# rate limit rule
POST /policies/rate-limit { "service":"org-lookup","limit":120, "window_s":1 }
```

reza (sre): logs show 502s from billing decreased after their scale; overall 5xx for control-plane down to ~1.5% after both sides scaled + fallback.

emma (oncall): status: mitigated. moving to monitoring phase. action items before handoff: 1) revert cached fallback only after billing confirmed stable and no regression tests fail 2) followup bug to add graceful degradation paths in org-lookup 3) postmortem owner: reza 4) customer comms draft and timeline: nina

nina (support): customer comms sent to 4 customers that reported errors, ops/status page updated.

sam (product): we should add an opt-in tolerant mode for org-lookup consumers to explicitly accept cached metadata; adding feature request.

emma (oncall): handing off to reza for on-call rotation at 3015551400. if anything regresses ping #inc-urgent and page oncall.

reza (sre): taking handoff. will run forensic queries and start postmortem doc. initial notes: cascade from billing conn-pool -> org-lookup timeouts -> gateway 502s. mitigation: cached fallback + gateway CB + billing scaling + rate-limits.

ops-bot: incidentbot: Incident marked mitigated at 3015551200, severity: SEV2, runbook: org-lookup-cascade.

emma (oncall): thanks team. we'll close once postmortem and followups are tracked. :thumbsup:
